meta.scope: Uruguay batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from INE Uruguay catalogue top-down: institutional identity, ECH (labour + poverty), IPC, national accounts anchors, and Banco Central del Uruguay. Definition locked.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.description: National statistical office of Uruguay. Produces the core official statistics (prices, household surveys, poverty, national accounts inputs, census, etc.) and coordinates the national statistical system.
referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central del Uruguay statistical publications that cite INE sources
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Uruguayan official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.

candidates.title: Encuesta Continua de Hogares (ECH) / Continuous Household Survey
candidates.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with Montevideo / Interior domains.
candidates.notes: Central social and labour survey. Continuous high-frequency operation. Official source for both labour statistics and monetary poverty. Recent poverty (persons) in the mid-to-high teens percent range under the updated methodology.

candidates.title: Pobreza por el método del ingreso / Income poverty
candidates.description: Official income-poverty and indigency incidence, calculated by comparing household income (from ECH) with nationally defined poverty and indigency lines. Published with Montevideo / Interior and other breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. 2025: persons under the poverty line ~16.6–17.7% depending on semester; indigency ~1.5–1.8%. Methodology updated in recent years (new baskets and economies of scale). Uruguay records among the lower income-poverty rates in the region.

candidates.title: Líneas de pobreza e indigencia
candidates.description: Monetary values of the poverty and indigency lines (per capita / household), differentiated for Montevideo and the Interior and updated with price information.
candidates.notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. Separate lines for Montevideo and Interior reflect cost-of-living differences.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco Central del Uruguay and into the updating of poverty lines.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Uruguay
candidates.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Quarterly and annual releases.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. BCU plays a central role in the compilation and dissemination of the national accounts.

candidates.title: Banco Central del Uruguay — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, and inflation analysis under an inflation-targeting regime.
candidates.notes: In the Uruguayan division of labour INE leads prices, household surveys and poverty; the BCU leads national accounts, monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts inflation-targeting policy.

candidates.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (IPoM)
candidates.description: Quarterly Monetary Policy Report of the central bank. Explains recent inflation, the outlook, and the implications for the monetary-policy stance under the inflation-targeting regime.
candidates.notes: Flagship policy communication product. Complements higher-frequency monetary-policy statements.

candidates.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by ECH design and poverty analysis.

candidates.title: Índice de Pobreza Multidimensional (IPM)
candidates.description: Official multidimensional poverty index capturing deprivations across multiple dimensions beyond income. Complements the income-poverty series.
candidates.notes: Complementary structural poverty measure. Recent estimates place multidimensional poverty in the high teens percent range, with higher incidence outside Montevideo and among children and Afro-descendant populations.

proposed_edges.basis: Income poverty is calculated from ECH household income data.
Poverty status is determined by comparing household income with the official poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with price information derived from the IPC.
The Monetary Policy Report is a core publication of the Banco Central del Uruguay.
ECH is a core continuous survey of INE.
IPC is produced and disseminated by INE.
Multidimensional poverty draws on household-survey information alongside other sources.
